answer: At dawn each epoch opens a fraud-proof window: rewards are not paid at once but held for three epochs, so any peer can challenge a suspect identity and trigger re-execution of its work. A Sybil farm faces a simple cost: every fake identity's earnings sit frozen on the horizon while auditors examine them, and a single proven fraud burns the whole batch plus the sponsor's stake. Honest agents see only a ripple in payout timing; attackers lose weeks of locked capital the moment one clone is caught.
